best_for: Writers and developers who write in Markdown every day and want to see the formatted text as they type, on up to 3 of their own computers.

points.title: One payment, no subscription
points.text: A license is USD 14.99 before tax, paid once with no renewal fee. It covers one person on up to 3 devices across macOS, Windows and Linux. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Try it for 15 days
points.text: You get a 15-day free trial before you have to buy. Refunds can be requested within 30 days.

points.title: No split preview
points.text: Typora renders Markdown in place as you type, so there is no second pane and you do not see the syntax marks unless you edit them.

points.title: Exports for real documents
points.text: It exports to PDF with bookmarks, Word, LaTeX, EPUB and more, renders math with MathJax, and draws Mermaid, flowchart and sequence diagrams.

points.title: One license per person
points.text: There are no bulk licenses. Each person needs their own, and separate user accounts or virtual machines count as separate devices.

points.title: Linux Flatpak is not verified
points.text: The Flathub package carries Typora's name but Flathub does not mark it as verified. Windows installers come per-user and machine-wide for x86, x64 and Arm64; the Mac build needs macOS 12 or later.

points.title: Older Windows versions kept
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 16 versions. macOS and Linux list only the current release.
